tasks.title: Deploy UI
tasks.description: Build Vue UI with Vite and deploy to public/

tasks.title: Deploy UI (skip build)
tasks.description: Deploy existing dist/ to public/ without rebuilding

tasks.title: Start Dev Server
tasks.description: Start the WebGit development server with file watching

tasks.title: Kill Port 3000
tasks.description: Find and kill the process listening on port 3000 to free it up
tasks.command: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs -r kill -9 && echo 'Port 3000 freed' || echo 'Port 3000 was not in use'

tasks.title: Restart Dev Server (kill + start)
tasks.description: Kill existing process on port 3000, then start dev server with file watching
tasks.command: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs -r kill -9 && npm run dev
